description: AI-native pet task buddy: add tasks by chat or voice, a virtual cat reacts to your progress, with weekly/monthly/yearly reports (category pie + completion bars) and durable per-user cloud storage.
author: petdo

tools.name: parse_text
tools.description: Parse a free-text sentence describing one or more tasks (e.g. "明天下午3点写周报", "buy milk, call mom") into structured draft tasks (title, category, priority, due date). Returns drafts for confirmation; does NOT save anything.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Save one task. Use after the user confirms a parsed draft, or when title and details are clear.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as done. Awards pet XP (more for high priority and on-time completion).

tools.name: uncomplete_task
tools.description: Reopen a completed task and deduct the XP it awarded.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task's title, category, priority or due date.

parameters.name: due
parameters.description: New due date YYYY-MM-DD; pass empty string to clear

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks. filter=today (due today or overdue, undated tasks, plus done today), overdue, week (due within this week), or all (newest first). Returns the pet snapshot too.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Full snapshot for hydrating the app window: all tasks, pet state (xp/level/mood/streak), and meta.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregated stats for a period: per-category totals/done (for pie chart), completion rate, daily (week/month) or monthly (year) buckets.

parameters.name: anchor
parameters.description: A date inside the period, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

tools.name: summarize_period
tools.description: Write a short AI report for week/month/year based on task stats. Use when the user asks for a summary or review.

parameters.name: anchor
parameters.description: A date inside the period, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

tools.name: pet_pat
tools.description: Pat the cat. Returns the pet state and a mood-based message (_zh Chinese / _en English). Just for fun.
